feeds.title: Annegram
feeds.description: Today, there are various websites that provide services for the topics that many expectant mothers are curious about. One of them is annegram, we combine the original content of the site with the images, and we provide detailed information on the topics of interest, from pregnancy to baby care.

feeds.title: Anne Kaz
feeds.description: Hello, this is the diary of a working woman, married for 21 years, mother of three. She writes everything that comes to his mind, eats, drinks, travels, loves, extracts a share of happiness from every moment of life, and shares it.

feeds.title: Fundalina
feeds.description: Funda graduated from CEIT and worked as an Information Technologies Teacher. She continues her publishing life on her own website and writes a column in magazines. Yalcin, one of the rare female writers in the field of technology in our country, also produces content in this field and takes place in the writer staff of various corporate blogs.

feeds.title: Yeşim Mutlu
feeds.description: I am an Istanbul based photographer, blogger and mother of 3 girls. I founded my YSM Photo Blog in 2005 when I was living in Istanbul. YSM Photo Blog is a pioneering lifestyle blog especially in Turkey and in the world. It is full of different posts and photos, from how to take a child photo to how to take a vacation photo. My blog is about beauty, health, food, fashion, technology, social media and more.

feeds.title: Ozlem's Turkish Table
feeds.description: I am Ozlem. I was born and bred in Turkey and lived there for 30 years. I feel very fortunate to be a part of this rich and welcoming culture. Turkish cuisine is healthy, delicious, affordable and most recipes are very easy to make. Here, I would like to show you how you can recreate these wonderful recipes in your own home.

feeds.title: Banu'nun Dünyası
feeds.description: The world in which an educator tells about her personal mission, vision, perspective on life, sometimes by living it. Banu is the author behind the blog and a mother herself.

feeds.title: Turkish Food Travel
feeds.description: I am a Food Writer, a Youtuber, and a chef of my home in Istanbul. I have shared more than 1000 recipes online since 2005. I continue to make online content, especially about Turkish cuisine, food, travel, and Istanbul trips on my channel both in English and Turkish.

feeds.title: Safagin Dunyasi
feeds.description: Life blog, which is created by the mother and female blogger named Safagin Dunyasi, who covers all the issues in life.

feeds.title: Living The Turkish Dream
feeds.description: I am Danni. While on tour, I met a Turkish guy and I moved to Turkey to be with him. I figured a blog would be the perfect place for me to discuss things I'm passionate about and give people an insight into what life is really like living in a foreign country far away from family, friends, and everything I've ever known.

feeds.title: Portakal Ağacı
feeds.description: Portakal Agaci was born in 2003 as the shelter of a 23-year-old girl. The only thing on my mind was to produce something in the kitchen where I felt at peace and share it with the world. Later on, the Orange Tree became a Studio, and I became a mother of 3 children and 1 cat.

feeds.title: Bahareli
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Bahar Elkovan. I was born in 1981 in Ankara. I graduated from Hacettepe University Fine Arts Faculty.I decided to get married and became the mother of a daughter in 2010. Her name is Asya. I started writing this blog page when Asya was diagnosed with a food allergy when she was 3 years old. While researching what I can do on the Internet, I could find very few resources and saw that there was no awareness in general.

feeds.title: Dağınık Anne
